description: Header file defining BSD socket wrapper functions and structures for cross-platform networking, including socket creation, configuration, and address handling.

classes.name: bsd_addr_t
classes.description: Structure representing a BSD socket address with storage, IP, and port information.

methods.name: bsd_sendmmsg
methods.description: Send multiple messages on a socket.

methods.name: bsd_recvmmsg
methods.description: Receive multiple messages on a socket.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_payload_length
methods.description: Get payload length of UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_payload
methods.description: Get payload data from UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_peer
methods.description: Get peer address from UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_local_ip
methods.description: Get local IP from UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_packet_buffer_ecn
methods.description: Get ECN info from UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_create_udp_packet_buffer
methods.description: Create a new UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_udp_buffer_set_packet_payload
methods.description: Set payload in UDP packet buffer.

methods.name: bsd_write2
methods.description: Write header and payload to socket.

methods.name: bsd_would_block
methods.description: Check if socket operation would block.

methods.name: bsd_create_listen_socket
methods.description: Create a listening socket for IPv4/IPv6.

methods.name: bsd_create_listen_socket_unix
methods.description: Create a Unix domain socket for listening.

methods.name: bsd_create_udp_socket
methods.description: Create a UDP socket bound to host and port.

methods.name: bsd_create_connect_socket
methods.description: Create a socket and connect to host and port.

methods.name: bsd_create_connect_socket_unix
methods.description: Create a Unix domain socket and connect.
